label: D1 before an a2 choice, mid-episode, after unrewarded or rare a2 trials
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (99% of mass; the D1 policy logit is moderately negative, -8.9 to -1.5). The only FUTURE variable is the agent own upcoming choice (action at D1), which it computes; the observed proxy prev_action == 2 gives lower recall (0.80 vs 0.98). Magnitude is highest after unrewarded or rare previous trials (prev_reward == 0 or prev_common == 0) and builds up over consecutive such trials (e.g. 0.79 to 0.91 to 0.96 to 0.98). Weak or absent after common-rewarded a2 trials. Strongly modulated by episode position: active in trials 10-79, peaks around 30-39, silent after trial 80 and in the first few trials. D1 & action==2 alone: F1 0.43, mass recall 0.99; the full predicate: dev F1 0.64, mass recall 0.90. Precision stays incomplete, so this probably encodes a graded a2-preference/uncertainty signal in its magnitude.
